message.content:
You are doing deep, current (2025-2026) research to add new games to a game-server hosting product (Nxeon). Use WebSearch + WebFetch (load them first via ToolSearch query "select:WebSearch,WebFetch"). Verify specifics.

SCOPE — sandbox/source/misc cluster. Games: (1) Factorio (headless server), (2) Garry's Mod (GMod), (3) DayZ, (4) Conan Exiles, (5) Unturned, (6) The Forest & Sons of the Forest, (7) Minecraft Bedrock (distinct from Java: addons/behavior packs, cross-play).

For EACH game return a structured, buildable section:
- **Self-hostable?** confirm the dedicated/headless server.
- **SteamCMD app ID** (or install source, e.g. Factorio headless tarball; Bedrock server zip from Mojang) + install/update + start command.
- **Editions/versions/branches** to offer.
- **Mods/gamemodes/content ecosystem** owners expect one-click: Factorio mod portal + headless mod loading; GMod Steam Workshop collections + gamemodes (DarkRP/TTT/Sandbox/Prop Hunt) + addon management; DayZ mods (Steam Workshop) + maps (Chernarus/Livonia/Namalsk); Conan mods; Unturned Steam Workshop + RocketMod/OpenMod plugins; Bedrock behavior/resource packs & add-ons.
- **Key editable config file(s)** + the 8-15 most-tuned settings per game.
- **Resource baseline** (RAM/CPU per player tier).
- **Hosting demand signal**.
- **Verdict**: recommended default + 3-5 highest-value wizard options.

Note Unturned is free-to-play (good for a free-trial funnel) and Factorio is very lightweight. Concrete, itemized, with source URLs. Feeds backend + wizard + marketing.
